allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: The Board of Directors of the company in its meeting held today i.e., Saturday, February 14, 2026 has:1. considered and approved the unaudited standalone financial results of the company for thethird quarter and nine months ended on December 31, 2025 along with the Limited ReviewReport submitted by the Statutory Auditors.2. approved the proposed payments and ratified advances made to certain vendors towardsQuality Control equipment and Purified RO Water equipment i.e., for the purpose(s) notmentioned in the Rights issue Letter of Offer dated December 17, 2025.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: We are hereby submitting the trading approvals received from BSE and NSE vide their letters dated February 04, 2026 for the Equity shares allotted under Rights Issue of the Company.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: We would like to inform that the Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors of Vineet Laboratories Limited ( the Company ) has today i.e. February 02, 2026, considered and approved the allotment of 99,87,258 Equity Shares of Face Value of Rs.10/- each on Rights Basis at an issue price of Rs.30/- per Equity Share (including a premium of Rs.20/- per Equity Share).

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: The Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors in its meeting held on January 13, 2026, has decided to extend the "Last date for On Market Renunciation" and the "Issue Closing date" for the benefit of the Investors. We are hereby submitting the revised dates.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: The Company is hereby submitting the Letter of Offer for Rights Issue.

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: Vineet Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights Issue is Tuesday, December 23, 2025.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: We hereby inform that the Rights Issue Committee of the Board in its meeting held today i.e. on December 17, 2025 has inter alia considered and approved the Rights Issue Price, Entitlement Ratio, Record Date, Issue Opening, Closing date and Letter of Offer.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: The Company has received the In-Principle approval(s) from National Stock Exchange of India Limited on December 02, 2025 and BSE Limited on December 16, 2025 for undertaking Rights Issue of Fully Paid-up Equity Shares of the Company.
